access.title: Category access
access.subtitle: Per-category RACI firewall rules — who can read, acknowledge, approve, and author.

noSelection.title: No category selected
noSelection.description: Select a category from the sidebar.

status.NONE: Saved · nobody is asked to acknowledge
status.ON_PUBLISH: Saved · asks once, on the first publish

rules.title: Rules
rules.order: top-down, first match per action wins
rules.subject: Subject
rules.empty: No rules — default deny applies to everyone.
rules.footer: Default: deny anything left blank · rules inherit down; own rules override ancestor rules.

addRule.title: Add rule
addRule.description: It joins the bottom of this category's rules, every action blank. Move it up to give it priority.
addRule.groupHint: The group's name in your identity provider.

merge.title: Merge accounts
merge.subtitle: Move one user's policies, acknowledgments, and grants onto another, then close the source account.
merge.irreversible: This can't be undone. The source account is closed after the merge.
merge.nothing: Nothing to move — the source account owns no records.
merge.sameUser: Source and target must be different users.
merge.privileged: This merge affects privileged records and requires an elevated confirmation.

activity.emptyDescription: Nothing recorded yet, or you don't have audit.read.
activity.title: Recent activity

saved.bannersDetail: They now show across both apps, on every page and at sign-in.

account.setupTokenHint: Setup token · Provided by your system administrator
account.title: First-run setup

done.finishSso: Finish enabling SSO: add the DNS record {{record}} with the value shown, then go to sign in.
done.notProvisionedLater: You can finish setting up SSO from Organizations after signing in.
done.title: Your root administrator is ready.

problem.already: This Steward is already set up.
problem.disabled: Setup is not enabled on this Steward.
problem.failed: Setup couldn't finish. Try again in a moment.
problem.oidc: OIDC requires the issuer and client ID.
problem.saml: SAML requires the IdP entity ID, SSO URL and signing certificate.
problem.ssoFields: Organization name, domain and identity provider are required.
problem.username: Username must be a plain username, not an email address.

sso.body: Connect your organization's identity provider now, or skip and set it up later.
sso.displayName: Display name (optional) · Shown on the sign-in screen
sso.localSignIn: Local sign-in is always available for the root administrator you just created, and you can turn on organization SSO at any time.
sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.verification: We'll create the connection and start domain verification. You'll publish a DNS TXT record, then finish testing and activation from Organizations.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Platform users, roles, and policy access.

empty.title: No users found
empty.description: No platform users match this search.

detail.subtitle: {{email}} · {{role}}
detail.closed: This account is closed and read-only.

profile.rootLocked: The root site-admin can't be disabled.
profile.name: Display name
profile.federated: Display name, email and password are managed in the directory and can't be edited here.

password.title: Reset password
password.description: Sets a new random password and shows it to you once.

welcome.title: Welcome email
welcome.description: Sends the account's welcome email again.

newPassword.title: New password for {{name}}
newPassword.description: Copy this now — it won't be shown again.
newPassword.label: Password

security.title: Second factors
security.empty: No authenticator or passkey enrolled — this user relies on their email code only.
security.renameHint: Leave it empty to use the default name.
security.resetDescription: This removes the method — the user must set it up again the next time they sign in.

rolesTab.baselineDescription: Baseline — every enabled user is a Reader.
rolesTab.noExceptions: No exceptions — this user can see every policy.

actAs.title: Act as this user
actAs.description: See exactly what {{name}} sees, for up to 30 minutes.
actAs.dialogDescription: You will assume this user's roles and access with full write capability. A persistent banner will show while you are acting as them, every action is audited under your own identity, and the session ends automatically after 30 minutes. High-risk actions (password/MFA, deletions, role changes) stay blocked.
actAs.notAllowed: Site admins and the root can't be acted as.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.dialogDescription: All active sessions for {{name}} are revoked immediately… This is reversible; the user can simply log back in.

root.title: Root site-admin
root.onlyRoot: Only the current root ({{name}}) can do this.
root.alreadyRoot: This user is the root site-admin.
root.dialogDescription: This demotes the current root and makes {{name}} the root site-admin… This cannot be undone, and only the current root can do it.
root.next: Next: confirm with an email code.
root.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.rootProtected: The root site-admin can't be deleted.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: Re-assign their owned policies first, then review what will be removed.
deleteDialog.blocked: This account can't be deleted yet
deleteDialog.confirmDescription: This closes the account, revokes its sessions and drops its access. It never deletes a policy.

myGroups.title: My groups
myGroups.subtitle: Add or remove the members of the groups you manage. Memberships synced from your identity provider are read-only.
myGroups.heading: {{name}} · {{count}}

empty.title: No managed groups
empty.description: You don't manage any groups. Ask a site administrator to make you a group manager.
